name: fem_cantilever_deflection
_comment: CST linear tetrahedra exhibit shear locking in bending. The 10x2x2 mesh under-predicts the analytical Euler-Bernoulli tip deflection by ~57% because constant-strain tets cannot represent bending modes well on a 2-element-thick beam. Monotone h-convergence is preserved (25% at 20x4x4, 13% at 30x6x6, 8% at 40x8x8); see test_cantilever_h_refinement. Tolerance is set to 1.2x measured rel_err rounded to the next 0.05.
